description: Build a weekly chore chart for family members — assign chores per day and print it.

faqs.a: Add family member names, then add chore names. Click any cell to cycle through: empty → member initials assigned. Then print.
Clicking a cell cycles through family members one by one, then back to empty — tap until the right person shows.
Click Print Chart to open a print-friendly version in a new window.
faqs.q: How do I print the chart?

faqs.a: In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.

howto: Click cells to assign a person to each chore/day.
Click Print Chart for a paper-friendly copy.
title: Chore Chart Maker
